editorial:
Imagine being young, in love, and thinking you found a shortcut to getting rich quick. You get to see this play out through two lovers in Iowa who decide to start cooking meth in their own home. It starts off as a wild dream where they think they are in control, but the vibe quickly shifts from exciting to scary. You can really feel how their relationship starts to crack as the drug takes over every single part of their lives, turning their small town world into a nightmare.

The acting feels very real, and the way the story speeds up makes you feel the pressure the characters are under. While some parts might feel a bit slow, the raw emotion makes it worth your time. If you like gritty stories about people making bad choices, you will love this. You should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great move. Renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to see if you dig the style.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart as the addiction and the crime catch up to the couple. The fantasy they built together breaks, leaving them broken and alone. You see that the money and the power they wanted were never worth the cost. The story wraps up with a sad realization that they destroyed their future. It ends on a heavy note, showing that once you go down this path, there is often no way back to a normal life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raw stories about addiction and bad decisions.
